conclusion: jdi-issue (Act) specifies 3 of 5 categories: 2 autonomy limits, 3 validation rules, 7 escalation rules; none for clarification rules, approval gates. Strongest: escalation rules.

autonomy_limits.conclusion: 2 autonomy limits (2 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly frontmatter: Claude allowed tools; taking Continue at the loop's human gate.
